title: Geometry - Lesson 6 Assessment: Area Unit Conversion
description: Show mastery of square centimeter and square meter conversions and the reason area uses squared units.

questions.question: Which unit is best for measuring the area of a classroom floor?
questions.explanation: A classroom floor is a surface, and square meters are appropriate for larger areas.

questions.question: Convert 8 m² to cm². Enter just the number.
Convert 36000 cm² to m². Enter just the number.
A square meter contains 100 rows of 100 square centimeters.
questions.explanation: A 1 m by 1 m square is 100 cm by 100 cm, giving 10000 square centimeters.

questions.question: What operation converts cm² to m²?
questions.explanation: Square centimeters are smaller, so divide by 10000 to express the same area in square meters.

questions.question: A board has area 0.6 m². Convert it to cm². Enter just the number.
A tabletop has area 12000 cm². Convert it to m². Enter just the number.
A student says 5 m² = 500 cm² because 1 m = 100 cm. Identify and correct the mistake.
questions.correctAnswer: The student used the length conversion factor. Area uses two dimensions, so 5 m² = 5 × 10000 = 50000 cm².
questions.explanation: The correction should use the area conversion factor, 10000.

questions.question: A rectangular wall is 3 m long and 2 m high. What is its area in cm²? Enter just the number.
questions.explanation: The area is 3 × 2 = 6 m², and 6 × 10000 = 60000 cm².

questions.question: Explain how you know whether to multiply or divide by 10000 in an area conversion.
questions.correctAnswer: Multiply by 10000 when converting from m² to cm². Divide by 10000 when converting from cm² to m².
questions.explanation: The same area has a larger number in smaller square centimeters and a smaller number in larger square meters.
